text: Gomɗii Allah welano gomɗimɓe ɓen, tuma ɓe yeeyondiraynoo e maaɗa ka ahodal Hudaybiyya e ley leggal. O anndi gomɗinal e laaɓal e goonga ko woni e ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, O jippini deeƴere nden e ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, O warjoriiɓe ɗum, uddital Khaybara ɓaɗtiingal, ko lonntinana ɓe kon ko laawinooɓe naatugol Makka.
